footer.about: {brand} structures U.S. real estate projects for Brazilian investors through EB-5.
footer.legalNotice: This page is for information only. It is not an offer to sell, or a solicitation of an offer to buy, any securities. Any offer would be made only through an offering memorandum, which {brand} shares only with accredited investors. Investing in an EB-5 project carries risk, including the loss of capital. Approval, timing and the green card depend on U.S. immigration authorities, and no result is guaranteed. Consult an immigration attorney and a tax advisor before you decide. Program figures are as of October 2026, from USCIS and U.S. law (8 U.S.C. 1153), and will be adjusted for inflation for petitions filed on or after January 1, 2027.
